attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a mouth that matches the source expression. Preserve the real source hair, specifically bareheaded short combed-back dark brown hair, and real dark eyebrow hair. Maintain the clean understated upper lip and chin with a serious closed mouth, ensuring no moustache or beard is added. Keep the actual image-left three-quarter head direction and roll. The clothing must remain a dark olive closed upright-collar military tunic with exact primary closure, featuring actual gold rectangular embroidered collar patches and limited gold shoulder area, along with source-exposed brown fastening or strap fragments. Do not add a cap, glasses, open civilian lapels, white Western shirt, or tie. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open or closed garment and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Fine collar engraving and hidden decorations remain indistinct and understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short combed-back DARK BROWN hair, real dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth, actual IMAGE-LEFT three-quarter head direction/roll. DARK OLIVE CLOSED upright-collar military tunic, actual GOLD rectangular embroidered collar patches and limited GOLD shoulder area and source-exposed brown fastening/strap fragments only. Keep exact primary clothing closure, grey backing/light and note-limited crop. No cap, glasses, moustache/beard, open civilian lapels, white Western shirt or tie. Fine collar engraving/hidden decorations indistinct remain unspecified.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
